scope: Python runtime modules under core plus public top-level facades
review_policy: The local quality suite enforces these limits; GitHub CI is disabled. runtime_lines is 19916 to cover descriptor-relative selected-file apply and backups that reject symlink swaps and verify copied source hashes, plus path-safe, non-overwriting artifact backups, symlink-safe bounded chat file reads and atomic writes that reject parent swaps, bounded voice-file downloads and transcription inputs, per-chat voice request IDs that discard stale transcriptions, atomic no-overwrite creation when a workspace file appears during a write, Telegram error redaction using configured secrets, content and mode snapshot checks that refuse stale workspace edits, symlink-safe private long-response artifact writes, atomic job/lane recovery, bounded resume attempts, blocking multi-agent approval when executable commands are hidden, preserving valid Telegram HTML while splitting rendered messages, collision-safe task workspace allocation, cleanup after failed task ownership registration, strict receipt schema typing, cron retry after transient scheduler errors, named invalid integer settings, current DeepSeek model defaults with legacy ID migration, rejecting cron timestamps and intervals outside the supported localtime range in user input and stored jobs, confining acceptance-command working directories to their workspace while exposing the cwd in approval previews, skipping voice downloads when transcription is unconfigured, chunking long approval previews with action buttons on the final reviewed chunk, confining acceptance file, handoff, and glob checks to resolved workspace paths, giving acceptance commands a minimal environment while disclosing their host access in approval and security documentation, scrubbing Git checkpoint environments, rejecting artifact-workspace symlinks before resolving, rejecting dangling JSON state symlinks instead of returning defaults, preserving cron schedules when stored JSON is unreadable or malformed, refusing skill-state writes/deletes and model or heartbeat runs when stored skill approvals are unreadable or malformed, enforcing delegated-process timeouts while prompt stdin or output streams are blocked, terminating workers on output-stream read failures, binding selected-file apply to a confirmed SHA-256 plan of source/target content and permissions while refusing to overwrite a target that appears during apply, staging all selected sources before any target replacement to avoid partial applies, rolling back backups created when preparation fails, and anchoring task undo and ownership-record access and updates to one opened workspace descriptor. Revisit after removing comparable runtime code. Raising a limit requires an ADR or an explicit architecture-budget rationale in the same review.
runtime_line_budget_rationale: The 265-line increase centralizes descriptor-relative no-follow filesystem helpers, replaces duplicated artifact traversal, applies them to bounded chat file reads, stale-write checked atomic updates, no-overwrite creates, and private long-response artifacts so symlink swaps cannot redirect workspace writes or block reads on named pipes, rejects oversized voice files and stale per-chat transcriptions, redacts known credentials from Telegram network errors and tracebacks before logging, and pins task undo deletion and ownership-record reads/updates to one opened root so a root symlink swap cannot redirect removal or metadata writes. Revisit after removing comparable runtime code.
